messages:
maria-peopleops: Heads-up — new intern (Bangalore) starts Mon 2026-04-05. Candidate is remote in IST, not a US resident. Need plan for I-9 / verification, BG check intake, benefits eligibility, laptop courier, and a timezone-friendly orientation. /cc @taro @eli-hr

Taro: Thanks — hiring manager here. Candidate is an early-career contractor (student internship). No SSN, won't be in the US. Wants full access to code on day 1 for onboarding tasks.

eli-hr: Quick policy: if the worker is located outside the US and not a US citizen/green card holder, we do NOT complete a US I-9. Instead we either: (1) hire via local payroll (if we have entity) or (2) engage as a contractor and collect tax/KYC docs (W-8BEN for independent contractors, or local equivalent). Benefits: not eligible for US benefits unless we have local programs.

maria-peopleops: OK — we'll treat as contractor for now until payroll confirms. For BG check: our vendor supports India but needs explicit consent and a local phone number. @onboard-bot can you generate the consent link and kick off the vendor flow? Also we need a laptop courier ETA and orientation recording + a buddy for timezone sync.

onboard-bot: Consent link created and sent to candidate (sent 2026-03-28 14:12 UTC). BG vendor: Checkr International — candidate email on file. Candidate was asked to share local phone + govt ID scan.

dev-ops: Laptop: can ship DHL Express to Bangalore. Typical ETA 3–5 business days once label created. I can generate a label if we have the start address. Provisional build: laptop will be imaged with dev image and VPN certs disabled until BG clears.

tara-dev: I can be the buddy. Suggest 30-min sync slots Wed/Thu 11:30–12:00 IST. I'll prepare a short "day 1" checklist and an orientation deck tailored for async folks.

eli-hr: Note on BG timing: India checks typically 7–10 business days if we need education/employment verifications. We should gate production creds until checks clear. For immediate tasks, provide sanitized dev data and limiting roles.

Taro: Makes sense. Please add a flag to the onboarding task to restrict access to secrets and prod services until BG status == cleared.

maria-peopleops: Will do. Action items: (1) @onboard-bot: consent link + BG kick (done), (2) @dev-ops: shipping label once address confirmed, mark VPN/prod creds locked until cleared, (3) @tara-dev: buddy + 1:1 slots, (4) @eli-hr: confirm contractor tax form to send (W-8BEN or local equivalent). I'll also share the orientation recording + benefits Q&A doc link for APAC hires: https://redwood-internal/onboarding/apac-onboard 

Taro: Candidate confirmed address in Bangalore and accepted DHL. Also flagged that time-zone overlap is limited — please add an optional pre-recorded "live" orientation that they can watch before 1:1.

maria-peopleops: Great — I'll upload the recording and send calendar invites for the buddy sessions in IST. Will also put a note in the hire ticket to re-evaluate payroll vs contractor if this becomes longer than the 3-month internship. :thumbsup:
